title: 01 · Orchestration, configuration and owner decisions
description: The voyage command follows STAGES, loads role configuration and asks the owner at PLAN, REPAIR, merge and LOCK. Prompts in agents/ take effect only when a command actually loads them.

steps.why: Identify the target, stages, probe and command overrides.
steps.guard: Target must contain .git; stage must be in STAGES
steps.failure: Return 2 for an invalid target or stage
steps.risk: Checks only for a .git path; repository trust is not verified

steps.why: Get the target name, scanner set, probe and owner mode from the registry.
steps.guard: --path takes precedence over the named target
steps.failure: An unknown name does not create a target
steps.risk: Stale configuration can diverge from the target

steps.why: Assign write, verify and audit from config.toml or VIBE_LLM_CONFIG.
steps.guard: Merge DEFAULTS; do not read an API key from the file
steps.failure: A missing CLI fails at its stage
steps.risk: Arbitrary CLIs have host privileges; small models have not been fully evaluated

steps.why: Record or ask for a decision; never approve automatically.
steps.guard: Random ID, nonce/binding, timeout and one-time answer consumption
steps.output: choice, note; QUESTION/ANSWER in file mode
steps.failure: Invalid answer or timeout raises an exception and blocks voyage
steps.risk: Anyone who can write the answer directory may impersonate the owner

steps.why: Run in fixed order even when --stages lists another order.
steps.guard: An rc or exception stops the loop
steps.failure: A failed stage returns 2 and records state
steps.risk: --stages permits stage omission; REPAIR checks only part of preflight itself

steps.why: An advisor or template creates the plan; plan_check runs before owner approval.
steps.guard: plan_check=0 plus accept required before saving hash/SHA
steps.failure: Rejection or three failed attempts stops
steps.risk: Approval file sits beside evidence and has no signature

steps.why: Check plan hash and HEAD; ask before execution and again before merge.
steps.guard: Hash and target HEAD must match
steps.risk: Subprocesses have host privileges; the worktree is not a sandbox

steps.why: The owner decides whether to run drift checks when a target has rulesync.
steps.guard: Explicit accept/reject
steps.failure: Nonzero exit blocks when checks run
steps.risk: Accepting with no configuration leads to a skip

title: 02 · MAP, PROVE and the evidence path
description: This path separates repository mapping, scanners, parsers, baselines and reports. Each tool has an ok/skipped/failed status; scanner output alone does not establish complete coverage.

steps.why: Build a bounded context pack and target inventory.
steps.guard: Exit code must be 0
steps.risk: The pack may contain private data; review before sending to an LLM

steps.why: Count languages, large files, Git state and agent assets.
steps.guard: recon.json must exist
steps.risk: Recon is inventory, not proof of runtime flow

steps.why: Select scanners and run them concurrently.
steps.guard: Fanout must exit 0 before merge
steps.risk: A skipped scanner may still be accepted

steps.why: Launch one subprocess per tool in the manifest.
steps.guard: Thread pool; 1800 s per tool
steps.failure: Missing output creates a failed record
steps.risk: Time and cost grow with tools; scanners may have side effects

steps.why: Classify unavailable/skipped tools and construct pinned commands.
steps.guard: Configuration, manifest and tool must exist
steps.risk: An unknown listed tool does not fail fanout

steps.why: Normalize tool output into findings.
steps.guard: Parse failures or disallowed exits return an error
steps.failure: Missing parser/report or fatal exit fails
steps.risk: Some parsers still need stricter schema and coverage-byte checks

steps.why: Redact text, normalize paths and deduplicate severity.
steps.guard: Drop records without a file
steps.failure: Malformed raw JSON is listed in errors
steps.risk: Pattern-based redaction cannot guarantee PII removal

steps.why: Compare scanner lists/statuses and new findings.
steps.guard: Lost ok coverage blocks; delta key uses tool, file and rule
steps.risk: An old finding on a different line is not new; skip-to-skip still passes

steps.why: An independent entry point scans a registry target.
steps.guard: MAP/recon/fanout/merge must exit 0, artifacts must be fresh, at least one scanner ok
steps.failure: A failed step blocks baseline save
steps.risk: Skipped scanners still need a required/optional policy

title: 03 · Prompts, audit and team handoff
description: The audit role writes the review when its CLI runs. The fallback template contains real counts but is not a deep audit. Cross-check and number-check are currently advisory.

steps.why: Load the audit prompt through PROMPT_AGENT and invoke review_cmd.
steps.guard: Check README/REVIEW and PROPOSALS modification times
steps.failure: CLI failure produces a template with a notice
steps.risk: mtime is weak evidence; the prompt may miss the domain

steps.why: Provide a fallback when the agent writes no fresh files.
steps.guard: Attach a no-LLM-audit notice
steps.failure: Missing LLM output alone does not block REVIEW
steps.risk: A reader may mistake the template for a full audit

steps.why: Compare numerical claims with evidence and source.
steps.guard: Advisory result included in review
steps.failure: Checker failure does not block REVIEW
steps.risk: Qualitative claims and external citations are not verified

steps.why: Collect masked JSON for handoff.
steps.guard: Nonzero exit blocks REVIEW
steps.risk: Masking is heuristic; review manually before sharing

steps.why: Have the verify role inspect wrong counts, contradictions and missing evidence.
steps.guard: Runs only without a custom review command
steps.output: cross-check.md if the CLI writes it
steps.risk: Not a release gate or proof of independent audit

steps.why: Specialized prompts describe roles and expected output.
steps.guard: Only auditor_architecture loads directly in voyage
steps.output: Manual handoff if orchestrator invokes them
steps.failure: No automatic runtime fan-out across all auditors
steps.risk: Prompt assets may be mistaken for executed checks

title: 04 · PLAN, candidate, reviewer and rollback
description: A candidate runs in a worktree and passes scope, probe, scan and reviewer checks before the owner is asked to merge. A post-merge probe can trigger a conditional auto-revert. These are Git gates, not an operating-system sandbox.

steps.why: Check sections, verification per step, Scope and SHA.
steps.guard: Return 2 if the plan is missing or mismatched
steps.failure: An invalid plan cannot be accepted
steps.risk: The checker cannot prove that Verification steps are sufficient

steps.why: Check baseline, probe, clean target, HEAD and coverage.
steps.guard: Baseline SHA must match HEAD
steps.risk: _tracked_clean does not detect untracked target files

steps.why: Capture probe rc and stdout/stderr hashes.
steps.guard: Every rc must be 0
steps.failure: A failing baseline probe returns BLOCK
steps.risk: Output hashes are sensitive to nondeterministic output

steps.why: Create a candidate branch and invoke the writer.
steps.guard: Target HEAD and clean state must remain unchanged
steps.risk: The executor has host filesystem and network privileges

steps.why: Require changed filenames to stay within Scope.
steps.guard: Check Scope before and after reviewer
steps.risk: Malicious content in allowed files still needs reviewer scrutiny

steps.why: Commit the candidate for a real merge and compare probes.
steps.guard: Probe rc and hash must match before
steps.failure: Commit failure or probe mismatch returns REVISE
steps.risk: A probe cannot cover every behavior

steps.why: Scan candidate with the baseline scanner set.
steps.guard: No failures, lost coverage or new findings
steps.risk: A scanner skipped in baseline can remain skipped

steps.why: Have an independent verify role write a clear verdict.
steps.guard: Candidate must be clean; stale verdict removed
steps.risk: A text verdict does not prove the reviewer ran tests

steps.why: Owner approves merge; compare SHA and run a post-merge probe.
steps.guard: Target HEAD and candidate SHA unchanged
steps.failure: Probe mismatch auto-reverts if HEAD is clean
steps.risk: Side effects outside Git are not rolled back

title: 05 · Multilanguage logic atlas and MIT release
description: The target analyzer builds a static graph; this repository explorer indexes every Python function in the harness itself. A public release must use a clean source snapshot, not the old Git history.

steps.why: Constrain scope to the target and read only Git-tracked regular files.
steps.guard: Reject path escape and symlinks
steps.risk: Untracked code does not enter the graph

steps.why: Build a static Python call graph with pinned Pyan.
steps.guard: max_files=400; uvx must be available
steps.risk: Dynamic dispatch and callbacks remain uncertain

steps.why: Build JS/TS import graph without executing target configuration.
steps.guard: --no-config; unresolved stays unknown
steps.failure: Partial for unresolved imports or Vue/Svelte
steps.risk: Event-to-HTTP/API edges are not linked

steps.why: Extract JS/TS/JSX/TSX functions, arrow variables and direct same-file calls.
steps.guard: Member/dynamic calls stay unknown; works without npx
steps.risk: Event, HTTP and cross-file calls are not linked

steps.why: Extract Rust/Go/Java/PHP/C# symbols and same-file calls.
steps.guard: Skip symlinks and files over 1 MB
steps.risk: Cross-file calls, cfg and reflection remain unresolved

steps.why: Export offline HTML/SVG/PDF with a full node/edge/unknown HTML catalog.
steps.guard: SVG preview limited to 120 nodes
steps.risk: A static catalog does not explain end-to-end behavior

steps.why: Index all functions, variables and calls in the harness without a 120-node cap.
steps.guard: Parse syntax; show unknown calls
steps.risk: Static calls are not runtime traces

steps.why: Smoke-test MAP/PLAN/REVIEW on synthetic fixtures through a budget model gateway.
steps.guard: Schema, plan_check and unsafe-verdict grader
steps.risk: Not an end-to-end executor/owner test

steps.why: Package fresh source without old Git history or reports.
steps.guard: Exclude reports/logs; reject symlinks
steps.risk: Still needs secret, license and manual content review

steps.why: Scan extracted source and verify scanned bytes are nonzero.
steps.guard: Do not exclude the entire root/public snapshot
steps.failure: Zero scanned bytes is a false green and blocks release
steps.risk: Zero matched patterns does not prove absence of sensitive data

steps.why: Prepare source for MIT release.
steps.guard: Do not push the old branch/history
steps.risk: External tool licenses and data need separate review
